newsitem.title: USA: Poll finds support for New Hanover Cty, N.C. bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poll finds support for New Hanover Cty, N.C. bonds.

text.p: A slim majority of voters in North Carolina's New Hanover County would approve a $125 million general obligation bond issue for schools according to a poll conducted by the North Carolina Institute of Political Leadership.
Fifty-one percent of the 366 respondents said they supported the bonds, 37 percent opposed them and 12 percent were undecided. The poll had an error margin if six percent.
Pollsters said the results bode well fore the referendum because undecided voters were likely to stay home, which would widen supporters' lead.

A date has not been set for the referendum, which school officials had hoped to schedule for May. They voted last week to ask the county commission for a referendum, but scheduling problems could delay it until the fall.
Bond proceeds would finance construction of five new schools and renovations at three others.
